name: samsung.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.
lesson: Use native HTML elements first. When you use ARIA roles, nest them the way the role requires.
summary: www.samsung.com scores 68 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 48 elements on /co/, /co/offer/, /co/smartphones/galaxy-s26-ultra/buy/, for example a[data-di-id="di-id-c84d277-780240a1"] and button[data-di-id="di-id-758d271b-f71d60b4"]. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 11 elements on /co/, /co/offer/, /co/smartphones/galaxy-s26-ultra/buy/, for example .nv00-gnb-v4__l0-menu-list--left and .nv00-gnb-v4__l0-menu-list--right. Impact: critical.

fix.title: 31 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1163 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /co/smartphones/galaxy-s26-ultra/buy/, for example div[aria-describedby="swiper14"][data-type-headline="slide 1: 헤드라인"][data-swiper-slide-index="0"]:nth-child(2) > .bc-gal and…
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Adobe Analytics (12 requests), Google Ads (7 requests), TikTok Pixel (5 requests), Microsoft Clarity (3 requests), Criteo (3 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), X Ads (2…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 1.2 s
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
